Practical note for anyone flying with an animal
It is easier with this note
Travelers with pets should read this before they check in.
Aurelia Skyways asks you to keep your travel papers ready, use a safe carrier, and tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk if your animal needs extra care. The desk gives calm, practical guidance and the senior coordinator helps settle daily service choices.
For rabbit travel, <<FACT F082>> Keep the animal comfortable, follow staff directions, and allow extra space for handling at the airport. Trained staff give patient attention to every animal, and small details make the trip smoother for you and your companion.
If you are unsure about any step, bring your paperwork to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
